pages.title: 封面 Cover
pages.prompt: Use the uploaded baby photo as the only identity reference. Preserve the baby's facial features, skin tone, age impression, and natural hair. Create one square 1:1 cover for a bilingual 0-3 year-old 颜色认知书. The main title should read exactly: "My First Colors". The Chinese subtitle should read exactly: "我的第一本颜色认知书". Beneath it, add the small English line: "A Bilingual Book for Babies" and the small Chinese line: "中英双语 · 0-3岁宝宝启蒙". Use rounded, highly legible sans-serif typography; make the English title playful with a refined natural rainbow palette, while keeping Chinese text dark and clear. Add a small pink circular badge in the upper-right that reads "0-3岁适用". Compose the baby as the clear central subject in a realistic, detailed professional baby portrait with soft warm daylight and natural skin texture. Theme scene: the baby in a playful but refined rainbow color-block outfit, surrounded by six clearly separated, friendly everyday objects in different natural rainbow colors; each object is a crisp white-outline cutout on a pure white page. Use a pure white (#FFFFFF) studio-paper page only, the requested color only, plus restrained warm-cream paper texture; keep the page background pure white accents, ample breathing room, subtle paper texture, and a few neat cutout-style elements with fine white outlines. DK children's encyclopedia style: premium early-learning editorial layout, white-background cutout-object collage composition, realistic baby photography blended with restrained children's illustration, bright but gentle, clean and modern. Do not create a busy room, scenic background, deep depth, extra people, watermark, border, illegible decorative text, collage panels, or 3D animation look.

pages.copy: This is Red. 这是红色。
pages.title: 红色宝宝页 Red Baby
pages.prompt:
Use the uploaded baby photo as the only identity reference. Preserve the baby's facial features, skin tone, age impression, natural hair, and Asian baby appearance. Create one premium square 1:1 bilingual color-learning picture-book card for ages 0-3. This is page 1; the single learning concept is "Red / 红色".

The baby is the central half-body subject. Dress the baby in a clearly red soft cotton romper or hoodie with a coordinated matching red fruit- or ladybug-inspired knit hat; the outfit color must be the strongest color on the baby and immediately communicate Red. Keep the baby in a natural, age-appropriate pose, gently touching, holding, or looking at one of the learning objects.

Use a PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) studio-paper background only: no colored full-page background, no room, no landscape, no scenic setting. Arrange exactly 5 or 6 clearly separated, easy-to-recognize red objects around the baby as small sticker-like cutouts with clean white outlines and generous breathing room. Use this object family: a red apple, strawberry, cherry, ladybug, red balloon, and red toy car. Objects should vary across fruit, animal, plant, toy, and simple everyday-object categories where natural; do not introduce competing color concepts. Add a few tiny red swatches, dots, or hand-drawn line flourishes, but keep the layout uncluttered.

The image must attempt to render the large, rounded, highly legible heading exactly: "红色 Red". Include this short bilingual sentence exactly: "This is Red. 这是红色。". Place the learning word large and prominent, with red lettering for the color word and dark charcoal supporting text. Add page number "1" in the lower-right. A small playful speech bubble may say "Let’s learn Red!" only if it remains legible and does not replace the required heading.

Style: bright but gentle children's encyclopedia and picture-book editorial design; realistic detailed baby photography blended with restrained friendly illustration, subtle warm paper texture, clean cutout collage, soft warm light, natural skin texture, high color clarity, low contrast shadows. No extra people, no busy composition, no deep background, no watermark, no border, no collage panels, no unrelated colors as visual focal points, no unreadable decorative text, and no 3D animation look.
